entities.name: Methanol
observations: Reactant incorporated into the methyl ester product.
Database-supported role: alcohol component for esterification or acid-chloride methanolysis.

entities.name: 4-Bromo-3-chlorobenzoic acid
observations: Acid substrate decoded from the reaction; its aryl bromide and chloride substituents are retained in the product.

entities.name: Methyl 4-bromo-3-chlorobenzoate
observations: Product formed by replacing the carboxylic acid hydroxyl with methoxy; no aryl-halide substitution occurs.

entities.name: Methanolic HCl
observations: Most direct precedent: methanol with HCl, consistent with Fischer esterification under acidic methanolic conditions.

entities.name: Oxalyl chloride DMF methanol
observations: Plausible alternative: oxalyl chloride with catalytic DMF in dichloromethane forms the acid chloride, followed by methanol alcoholysis to the methyl ester.
